headline: On US Discussion of Memory Production, SK Hynix Closes Strong
summary: SK Hynix surged more than 4% after news of discussions about producing memory chips in the United States emerged late in the session. Analysts said the move reflected expectations of an expanded local supply chain.
why: SK Hynix is a major South Korean supplier of DRAM and NAND memory chips, and its production decisions influence global semiconductor supply and pricing.

impacts.name: SK Hynix
impacts.why: Reports of potential US memory production were followed by a more than 4% share price gain in the session.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Late-session reports of discussions about producing memory chips in the United States drove the share price higher. Analysts linked the gain to expected expansion of its local supply chain and closer US customer ties.
